name: How to Merge PDF Files
description: Combine multiple PDF files into one document free — no upload, 100% private.

step.name: Add your PDF files
step.text: Click 'Choose files' or drag your PDF files into the drop zone. Add as many files as you need — there is no limit.

step.name: Reorder if needed
step.text: Drag and drop the file cards to set the order you want them merged in.

step.name: Download the merged PDF
step.text: Click 'Merge PDF'. Your combined file is generated in your browser in seconds and downloads automatically.
